VERDICT: FAIL

## Scale findings
- husk-a: DETAILS MINIATURE — doorway opening is ~14px tall and windows ~8px tall vs hero 24px (Beodeul house door on map is ~22-24px tall, log wall door is 32px; windows ~12-14px); make ground floor wall ~32px tall with a 22-24px door and 12px windows.
- husk-b: DETAILS MINIATURE — doorway is ~14px tall and windows ~7px tall vs hero 24px; enlarge ground floor features so door is ~22-24px tall and windows ~12px.
- husk-tall: DETAILS MINIATURE — crams 3 storeys + roof into 96px (~20px per storey, windows ~6-7px tall, doorway ~13px); in Beodeul a 2-storey house with roof is 108-128px (~28-32px per storey); reduce to 2 storeys in 96px or increase height to ~128px for 3 storeys, with 22-24px doors and 12px windows.
- husk-e: DETAILS MINIATURE — crams 2 storeys + roof into 80px (~22px per storey, doors ~14px, windows ~10px); make each storey ~28-32px tall (total height ~96px for 2 storeys + roof) with 22-24px doors.
- husk-g: DETAILS MINIATURE — crams 4 storeys + roof into 128px (~20px per storey, windows ~6x6px, ground door ~13px); reduce to 3 storeys in 128px (~30px per storey) with 22-24px doors and 12px windows.
- husk-h: DETAILS MINIATURE — crams 2 storeys + tall roof into 96px with tiny upper windows (~7x7px) and low ground garage bays (~16px tall, hero barely fits); make bays ~24-26px tall and upper windows ~12px tall.
- shack-a: TOO SMALL — total height 46px with ~22px wall and ~15px doorway (hero is 24px, cannot walk in without crouching; Beodeul small cabin is 64x64 with a 20px+ door); scale up to 64x64 (drawn height ~56-64px, wall ~28-32px, door ~22-24px).
- shack-b: DETAILS MINIATURE — total height 64px is okay, but the doorway is only ~16px tall (hero is 24px); raise the roof eaves so the front wall is ~28-32px tall and door is ~22-24px tall.
- shack-c: TOO SMALL — total height 47px with ~22px wall and ~15px doorway; increase to ~56-64px tall with ~28-32px wall and ~22-24px door.
- container-home: TOO SMALL — total height 44px with ~15px doorway and tiny ~6px windows; a shipping container must clear the 24px hero, so make the container body ~32-36px tall (total height ~48-56px) and doorway ~22-24px.
- lean-to: TOO SMALL — 31px tall (only 1.29x hero), roof eaves sit at ~16px so hero cannot stand under it; increase height to ~42-48px.
- tent-tarp: TOO SMALL — 32x32px with an opening ~14px tall (smaller than the 24px hero); enlarge to 48x48px (drawn height ~40-44px, opening ~20-22px) so the hero can plausibly crawl/fit inside.
- gate-scrap: TOO SMALL — 32x32px total with a walk-through gap only ~16px wide and ~18px tall; widen to 48x32px or 48x48px with a clear 24-32px opening and posts ~36-40px tall.
- car-rust-h: TOO SMALL — 48x32px (drawn 29px tall), cabin is ~14px tall and wheels ~7px (hero is 24px and towers over the car; Beodeul covered wagon is 64x48, drawn 42px); enlarge car to 64x32 or 64x48 (drawn height ~36-40px, length ~56-64px, wheels ~10-12px).
- car-rust-v: TOO SMALL — 32x48px, width ~26px is barely wider than the 16-20px hero; enlarge to 48x64px (drawn width ~36-40px, length ~56-64px).
- van-rust: TOO SMALL — 64x32px (drawn 28px tall, lower than the 29px car and barely taller than the 24px hero; Beodeul wagon is 42px tall); enlarge to 80x48px (drawn height ~42-46px, length ~72-80px).
- stall-a: TOO SMALL — 48x32px (drawn 32px tall), counter is ~10px high (shin-height on 24px hero) and awning clearance is ~16px (cuts hero at chest); increase height to 48x48px (drawn ~42-48px, counter ~14-16px high, awning clearance ~24-26px).
- stall-b: TOO SMALL — 48x32px (drawn 32px tall), awning clearance ~16px is shorter than the 24px hero; increase to 48x48px (drawn ~42-48px, clearance ~24-26px).
- market-shelter: TOO SMALL — 48x32px (drawn 30px tall), roof sits below the hero's head; increase to 48x48px (drawn ~42-48px tall).
- hut-sheet: TOO SMALL — 32x32px (drawn 31px tall) with a miniature ~12px doorway and ~6px window (looks like a doghouse next to the 24px hero); enlarge to 48x48px or 64x64px (drawn height ~48-56px, door ~22px).
- lean-doors: TOO SMALL — 48x32px (drawn 32px tall), doors used as walls/openings are ~16px tall vs Beodeul's 32px door; increase height to 48x48px (drawn ~44-48px, doors ~24-28px).
- shack-2f: DETAILS MINIATURE — 48x48px (drawn 48px tall) crams 2 full storeys into 48px (~20px per storey, doorways ~12-14px tall, hero is half the height of the entire 2-storey building); enlarge to 64x80px or 80x80px (drawn height ~72-80px, ~30px per storey, doors ~22px).
- hut-stove: TOO SMALL — 32x32px (drawn 32px tall) with a tiny ~12px door (reads as a dollhouse next to the 24px hero); enlarge to 48x48px (drawn height ~48-52px, door ~22px).
- dead-tree: TOO SMALL — 32x48px (drawn 48px, same as Beodeul's thin 1x3 cypress, whereas Beodeul's branching tree is 64x80px / 79px tall); enlarge branching dead tree to 48x64px or 64x80px (~64-76px tall) so it reads as a full tree rather than a sapling.
- lamp-broken: TOO SMALL — 16x32px (drawn 31px, barely taller than the 24px hero); streetlamps should tower over characters at 16x48px or 16x64px (drawn ~44-56px tall).
- wash-line: TOO SMALL — 32x16px (drawn 16px tall, comes up to the hero's waist, hanging shirts are ~5px tall vs hero's 24px body); enlarge to 48x32px (drawn height ~26-30px, posts shoulder-height ~24px, clothes ~10-12px).
- OK: crop-bed-b, crop-bed-c, wall-h, wall-v, wall-stub, wall-h2, barricade-h, fence-h, water-tank, generator, solar-scrap, campfire, log-seat, drums, tyres, crates, scrap-heap, rubble-pile, bush-wild, vine-wall, jersey-barrier, sign-blank, crates-plastic.

## Floor findings
- Dirt base texture: Wasteland dirt uses a dense, high-contrast 4-5 shade pixel-speckle pattern spanning ~3-4 value steps on every single 16x16 cell, creating severe visual static. In `map-beodeul-vineyard3` and `map-beodeul-mining7`, the brown dirt base is an almost completely flat fill with subtle 1-value-step soft patches and large stretches of solid color. Fix: flatten the dirt base to 2 close shades (1 value step apart), group pixels into soft 4-8px clusters instead of 1-2px noise, and leave at least 60-70% of each tile as flat base color.
- Road asphalt texture: The asphalt in `map-settlement4` is covered in high-contrast dark brown and light grey gravel blotches (~3 value steps from base, ~15-20 blotches per 3x3 cell area), making the road look like coarse rubble rather than pavement. Beodeul's cobbled paths use a low-contrast, soft, cohesive 1-2 step pattern. Fix: reduce asphalt contrast to 1 value step, remove the dark brown gravel spots from the base repeating tile, and keep 80% of the asphalt surface a calm, uniform dark grey.
- Curbs and concrete slabs: The concrete slabs and road curbs have heavy dark cracks, jagged black-outlined teeth along the bottom edge, and noisy 3-step mottling inside every tile. Fix: smooth the interior of concrete slabs and curbs to 1 value step of subtle variation, soften the bottom curb edge (remove the jagged saw-tooth notches on every tile), and restrict heavy cracks to occasional decal tiles.
- Ground decals (pebbles, red/grey rubble specks, yellow dry weeds, dark scorch/oil stains, potholes): In `map-settlement4` and `map-shanty3`, there are ~12-18 decals/tufts/pebble clusters per 10x10 cells, and the tiny 1-2px red/white/black pebble specks have extreme contrast against the dirt. Beodeul's mining dirt and grass maps have only ~2-4 small, low-contrast decals per 10x10 cells and maintain calm, completely empty floor areas of 6x6 to 10x10 cells. Fix: cut decal placement density by 70% (target 2-4 decals per 10x10 cells), ensure calm empty dirt/road areas of at least 6x6 to 8x8 cells, and reduce pebble decal contrast (remove bright white/red 1px highlights so they sit within 1-2 value steps of the dirt).

## Top 5 fixes in priority order
1. Flatten the dirt and asphalt base tiles: reduce texture contrast from 3-4 value steps down to 1 value step, eliminate 1-2px high-frequency speckle noise, and make 70-80% of the base ground tiles flat, calm color like Beodeul's dirt and grass.
2. Rescale all multi-storey building husks (`husk-tall`, `husk-g`, `husk-e`, `husk-h`, `husk-a`, `husk-b`) and `shack-2f` to match Beodeul's architectural scale: ~28-32px per storey, doorways 22-24px tall (so the 24px hero fits through), and windows 10-14px tall instead of cramming 3-5 miniature storeys into 48-128px.
3. Enlarge the miniature shacks, huts, and stalls (`hut-sheet`, `hut-stove`, `shack-a`, `shack-c`, `container-home`, `lean-to`, `lean-doors`, `tent-tarp`, `stall-a`, `stall-b`, `market-shelter`) by 1.4x-1.5x in height so doorways/awnings clear 22-24px instead of cutting the 24px hero at the waist or chest.
4. Enlarge the vehicles (`car-rust-h`, `car-rust-v`, `van-rust`) and small vertical props (`wash-line`, `lamp-broken`, `gate-scrap`, `dead-tree`) by ~1.3x-1.5x so cars/vans match the bulk of Beodeul's 64x48 wagon (42px tall) and clotheslines/lamps aren't waist-high on the hero.
5. Cut ground decal density and contrast on maps: reduce pebble/weed/scorch decals from ~15 per 10x10 cells to 2-4 per 10x10 cells, tone down bright/dark specks on pebbles and concrete curbs, and leave 6x6+ cell stretches of clean, uninterrupted ground.
